description: Free teaser. Call this before any paid wallet tool. Returns SOL balance, last active time, how many transactions landed in the last 24 hours, and a dormant or recently-active label. Does not spend USDC. Pass one base58 Solana address. Invalid addresses return an error and do not ask for payment. Upgrade to wallet_quick for a copy-trade screen, wallet_profile for priced holdings, or wallet_funding for the first SOL funder and cluster.

address.description: Solana wallet address in base58 (32 to 44 characters). Example: HD1ryR3dYSXBVNGfJZydbpmnChiE1wrAQkupWWtHt4pM

name: wallet_preview
